summary: Learn Kaizen and continuous improvement facilitation with PDCA, A3, value stream mapping, and practical workshop tools. Enquire today.
lede: Kaizen facilitation helps operations professionals turn process problems into structured improvement work. Designed for people who work with operational processes, the training covers setting baselines, using tools such as 5 Whys and fishbone analysis to identify root causes, and selecting countermeasures through team facilitation. It also addresses action tracking and control plans to help teams sustain and report improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with operational processes and need to facilitate structured improvement work, not just contribute ideas. It fits people who must diagnose problems, coordinate teams, document results, and keep gains in place across shifts, functions, or service channels.
modules: Kaizen Measurement and Root Cause Analysis
prerequisites: No prior coding or statistical programming is required. You will benefit most if you bring a laptop, a basic understanding of your process area, and access to recent operational data, SOPs, or improvement examples from your role.
